coverage.included: 2 selected, source-verified records; nonexhaustive unless explicitly stated in metric.
coverage.omitted: Unreported entities and unavailable measurements. No inference from absence.
coverage.missingness: Missing is unknown, never zero. Selected company cases are not a world census.

uncertainty: No local skill raster is packaged; these are global aggregate findings. Skill-gain coverage is not rainfall probability, skill magnitude or fraction of correctly forecast events. ERA5 is reanalysis, not direct gauge truth everywhere; this dataset cannot identify gauge-sparse countries. No source figures or model output assets copied; no live weather forecast generated.
limitations: No local skill raster is packaged; these are global aggregate findings.
Skill-gain coverage is not rainfall probability, skill magnitude or fraction of correctly forecast events.
ERA5 is reanalysis, not direct gauge truth everywhere; this dataset cannot identify gauge-sparse countries.
No source figures or model output assets copied; no live weather forecast generated.
